scope: All fields returned by the shared Owner AST inventory, including recipe progress and two private wrappers. Standard library internals are not state declarations. Maintenance snapshot helper fields are included solely as an evolution guard.
classification_scale: type.field declaration. A save action applies only below an included ancestor. wire_fields records existing codec inclusion independently: an encoded value may be inherited or rebuilt on load. No automatic format migration, codec generation or policy rewriting.

actions.save: Retain an explicitly encoded field within a supported durable branch; existing conditional cache refresh remains documented.
actions.inherit: Use the current session value on restore; a historical encoded speed field is not authoritative.
actions.rebuild: Rebind or recreate through the existing stable-main/pure map/reference projection policy without advancing consumers.
actions.discard: Exclude transient, omitted default or maintenance-only state from the player file; never synthesize a new gameplay value.
